# New Playnite theme

## New theme from a reference (design system, game, movie, or UI)

1. **Research & sources first.** Before scaffolding or coding without ready-made tokens, thoroughly research the reference using any available source (captures/screenshots, reference codebases/repos, style guides, or specs): sample/measure exact colors, note typography and Windows system fallbacks (a face Windows lacks is bundled in `src/Typography/`, only the weights used: [reference.md](reference.md) -> Bundled fonts), examine chrome/plates/tabs/radii, and pick matching icons. Record captures, repos, URLs, values, and design rules in `RESEARCH.md` (and link from `AGENTS.md` -> `Sources`). Research the source's *interface parts and motion* too (HUD bars, slots, cursors, toasts, menu transitions; frame-step captures), not only its colors: they feed the game element map.
   **Brief:** write a short `BRIEF.md` per [creative-direction.md](creative-direction.md) and decide everything yourself; later steps build what it names.
2. **Scaffold:** `.\scripts\new-theme.ps1 -Name "My Theme" -Key mytheme [-DesignSystem "My DS"] [-TokensCss <file>] [-Ambition Showcase|Hybrid|Faithful]` (writes `RESEARCH.md` and `BRIEF.md` skeletons; move step 1's notes and brief into them). Creates `src/themes/<Name>/` (`info/` manifests + `LICENSE-Playnite.txt`, `src/tokens.css`, `src/Constants.template.xaml` with palette and required shared brushes as `{{TODO}}`, `AGENTS.md`) and registers the index row.
3. **`src/tokens.css`:** the system's tokens under their own names (`:root` shared, a `dark` selector for the dark theme). Write var() aliases out; keep the alias in a comment.
4. **Previews first (before any XAML):** rewrite `art/preview-details.html` and `art/preview-settings.html` per [previews.md](previews.md) as the full design: every brief moment in its end state, real sizes, fonts, icons, states, `var(--token)` colors. Render with `.\scripts\take-screenshots.ps1 -Extension <key>` and look at both PNGs. Check them yourself against [the preview checklist](theme-preview-review.md). Do not spawn a reviewer or hand the checklist to another agent. Fix blocking findings in the HTML and re-render. Steps 5-9 translate those previews into XAML.
5. **`src/Constants.template.xaml`:** replace each `{{TODO}}` with the token that plays that key's role (the build fails until all are mapped). Map by role: `GlyphColor` = selection/checked accent, `TextColorDark` = text on accent, `HoverBrush` = hover fill, `SelectedBrush` = selected fill. `GameBannerTintBrush` (required) is the banner darkening color, picked from the source's brand palette (see Window background in step 8). Add optional shared keys as controls need them and the radius scale (`CornerRadiusSmall`/`Large`/`XLarge`/`Full`; `ControlCornerRadius` is the medium step). Brushes only in controls.
   **ThemeModifier:** Keep the ThemeModifier Edit constants list focused on main backgrounds, button fills and text, selection, and inputs. Include existing sidebar and panel surface brushes through the shared catalog. When panels share a brush or are transparent, use the existing background control. Keep the existing layout controls. Use the shared opt-ins in scripts/data/theme-keys.json and let the build generate thememodifier.yaml. Hover, pressed, and decorative colors stay in the theme. The accent picker lives in the Editor tab.
6. **`src/Common.xaml`:** `PopupBorder`, `FocusVisual`, spacing keys (`ButtonPadding`, `InputPadding`, `MenuPadding`, `MenuItemPadding`, `ComboBoxDropDownPadding`, `ComboBoxItemPadding`, `ListBoxItemPadding`, `GroupBoxPadding`, `TooltipPadding`, `IconSize`), and `GameBannerHeight` (default banner height, e.g. 320/340/360; edited in ThemeModifier), each with a comment quoting the spec.
   **Form field height:** define `<sys:Double x:Key="ControlHeight">32</sys:Double>` here, always 32, and keep vertical `InputPadding` and `ButtonPadding` at 5 (4 with thick borders), so the height is the same whatever the font. Every base `TextBox`, `PasswordBox`, `ComboBox` and `Button` style takes it, and the five overlays `new-theme.ps1` writes cover Playnite's own fields. The filter sidebar is a 28px exception; implement it after scaffolding using the filter sidebar rules in [reference.md](reference.md). Check ordinary fields in a game's edit dialog.
   **Banner darkening:** define `<sys:Double x:Key="GameBannerDarken">0</sys:Double>` next to `GameBannerHeight` (ThemeModifier slider `0,1`, default 0 so the designed banner is unchanged). Its color, `GameBannerTintBrush`, goes in `Constants.template.xaml` (see Window background below).
   **Metadata width defaults:** `GameDetailsPaneWidth` and `GridDetailsPaneWidth` both default to **300** (the scaffold defines them in `Constants.template.xaml`). They size the usable metadata content, matching Attache, in both details and grid views. Put the width on the content inside the pane's horizontal padding and frame so decorated themes retain 300px for labels and properties; keep the outer panel content-sized and preserve its spacing from the description. Verify both ThemeModifier width controls still resize the pane.
7. **`src/Media.xaml`:** the icon set as `Icon<Role>` geometries drawn by `IconTemplate` (`IconSearch`, `IconClear`, `IconViewSettings`, `IconFilterPresets`, `IconGroup`, `IconSort`, `IconDetailsView`/`GridView`/`ListView`, `IconUpdate`, `IconExplorer`, `IconRandom`, `IconViewRandom`, `IconFilter`, `IconNotifications`, `IconMainMenu`, `IconLibrary`, `IconStatistics`, `IconWindowMinimize`/`Maximize`/`Restore`/`Close`, plus `IconDropDown`, `IconSubmenu`, `IconCheck` as needed). Generate: `.\scripts\render-icons.ps1 -Pack <pack> -Icons search,x=Clear,three-bars=MainMenu -Format Geometry -KeyPrefix Icon` (stroked packs such as Lucide/Tabler need `-Format DrawingImage`). Playnite's own menu icons (`AddGameIcon`, `SettingsIcon`...) go in `src/themes/<Theme>/icons.json` as `Png` jobs mapped to `sys:String` paths (see Primer's `Media.xaml`/`icons.json`), then `.\scripts\render-icons.ps1 -Extension <key>`. Ship the icon license in `info/`.
8. **Shell:** (the filter toggle in `TopPanel.xaml` shows no "Filter Active" text: a 7-10px mark in the theme's own shape, filled `DataChangeNotifBrush`, on the icon's top-right corner while `Tag` is True; copy the pattern from Ancient's `TopPanelFilterToggle`; the validator checks it). `Views/MainWindow.xaml`, `Views/Sidebar.xaml`, `Views/TopPanel.xaml`, `DerivedStyles/MainWindowStyle.xaml`, `CustomControls/SidebarItem.xaml`, `CustomControls/TopPanelItem.xaml` (optionally `Views/Library.xaml`). Start each from Playnite's Default file, keep every `PART_*`, reserve the window buttons' width on the top bar's right. Navigation goes on the left: design the sidebar as a left rail (Playnite's default position); top/bottom are fallbacks only. Shared shell keys: styles `MainMenuButton`, `MainWindowButton`, `TopPanelSearchBox`; brushes `ShellBackgroundBrush`, `TopPanelBackgroundBrush`, `ContentBackgroundBrush`.
   **Grid side panel close button (required, every new theme):** In `Views/GridViewGameOverview.xaml`, use the shared 28×28 close-button template with a visible plate and a `DangerBrush` hover. Below `GameBannerHeight` of 120 px, place the X immediately left of the game icon at scroll top and keep it fixed and clickable as the content scrolls. Bind its vertical render translation to `PART_ScrollViewHost.ContentVerticalOffset`, use physical scrolling (`CanContentScroll="False"`), and stack the button’s header above the scrolling content. Show the fixed top-left X at 120 px and above and whenever no game is selected. Update both placements live as ThemeModifier changes the height, and preserve the behavior in any overview generator. Copy the [Night City grid overview](../../src/themes/NightCity/src/Views/GridViewGameOverview.xaml) pattern.
9. **Controls:** for each, open the Default file at the snapshot's Playnite tag, keep structure and part names, restyle to the system's component (name it and its tokens in the file header). Usual set: Button, ToggleButton, RepeatButton, TextBox (+`BareTextBox`), PasswordBox, ComboBox, CheckBox, RadioButton, Slider (`SliderRangeButton`, `SliderThumb`; one-line SliderEx), ProgressBar, ScrollViewer (`ScrollBarThumb`)/Thumb, ToolTip, ContextMenu/Menu (one-line GameMenu, GameGroupMenu, TrayContextMenu), TabControl, GroupBox, ListBox, SearchBox, DetailsViewItemStyle, GridViewItemStyle, PlayButton, WindowBarButton, HighlightBorder.
   **Settings screen (required, every theme):** `DefaultControls/TreeView.xaml` (the Settings section list: 28-32px full-width plates in the body font, distinct hover / selected states, the source's own selection motif, width trigger for `WindowSettings`) and `DerivedStyles/StandardWindowStyle.xaml` + `WindowBarButton.xaml` (a 36-48px title band carrying one signature graphic from the source). Not Playnite's default text list and flat bar. Concept, sizes (rows 28-32px, body font), the title trigger, the reserved scroll lane, motif table and the "Small things that went wrong before" table: [settings-screens.md](settings-screens.md); examples: Ancient, Attache, Cloudbank. `validate-extension.ps1` fails a theme without both files.
   **Game page:** `Views/DetailsViewGameOverview.xaml` and `Views/GridViewGameOverview.xaml` follow the skeleton and metadata pane in `src/themes/AGENTS.md` -> Game page, dressed in the system's components. Keep the proportional banner spacer via `{StaticResource MathConverter}` (`'x * <DefaultSpacer> / <DefaultBanner>'`) so normal banner heights preserve the designed title/gradient alignment. Never bind spacer height directly to `{DynamicResource GameBannerHeight}`.
   **Game page breakpoints:** Follow [Responsive game pages](reference.md#responsive-game-pages) in both views. Keep metadata beside the main content when the body fits the preferred pane width, the theme gap and 400px for content. Below that breakpoint, stack metadata in two columns at 560px of usable pane width or more, and one column below 560px. Apply `node scripts/game-page-breakpoints.mjs <details.xaml> <grid.xaml>` after creating the two overviews, or call the helper from the theme's overview generator. Verify both views with `pwsh -STA -File tests/wpf/GamePageBreakpointsRegressionTests.ps1 -Keys mytheme`.
   **Minimum top gutter (required in both views):** at banner heights **0, 5, 10 and 20**, the header must retain at least the content's side inset. Derive the spacer's `MinHeight` from that inset minus the header's existing top margins/padding, clamped to zero. Both the zero-height fallback and `HeroArt.Visibility=Collapsed` trigger set `Height` to this same floor: WPF retains a collapsed element's previous `ActualHeight`. An in-flow banner needs an equivalent gutter without counting its height/margins twice. Preserve these rules in overview generators.
   **Game-page verification (required for new themes):** check tiny/zero, default and hidden-art banners in **both details and grid views**, including live ThemeModifier changes. Run `pwsh -STA -File tests/wpf/DetailsViewLayoutRegressionTests.ps1`, `pwsh -STA -File tests/wpf/GridOverviewLayoutRegressionTests.ps1` and `pwsh -STA -File tests/wpf/SidePanelCloseButtonRegressionTests.ps1`. For the close button, scroll to the bottom at 119 px and confirm the X stays in place and clickable. Change the height to 120 px while the panel is open, then clear the selection to check the corner X. Keep each theme's own metadata spacing; check the first visible field when leading groups are hidden.
   **Window background and banner tint (required, every new theme):** full rules in [reference.md](reference.md) -> Window background and in the [theme guide](../../src/themes/AGENTS.md#window-background). The art layer spans the top bar and runs under the rail; the top bar, the rail, Expander headers (ship `DefaultControls/Expander.xaml`) and the scroll bar track go see-through or half-transparent while it is on ([checklist](theme-maintenance.md#window-background-game-art-behind-the-whole-window)). `validate-extension.ps1` (`Test-WindowBackground`) enforces the starred items, the rail, the track and the Expander.
   - **One art mode, Playnite's.** Game art behind the library comes only from Playnite's "Use game background image as window background" (Settings, Appearance, General). Add no theme or ThemeModifier option for it (Ayywi's "art fills the page" mode was removed for this).
   - **Full-strength art\*.** `Views/Library.xaml` shows `PART_ImageBackground` with no `Opacity`, `Visibility`, `Effect`, `OpacityMask` or scrim/tint layer over it: Playnite's darken and blur sliders are the only treatment. Never hide it (Launchpad did). Decor that doesn't depend on the art (a glow, grain, halftone) may stay.
   - **Soft bottom edge.** Put the image top-aligned in a `Grid` that sizes to it, with a gradient `Rectangle` from clear at 0.55 to the color behind the art (a collapsed `WindowArtSwatch` bound to that brush), so the art never ends in a hard line.
   - **See-through chrome.** A `{Settings ShowBackgroundImageOnWindow}` = True `DataTrigger` sets the top bar, filter and explorer panels and both game pages (`PageRoot` or the page's root fill, plus any opaque content row in `Library.xaml`) to `Transparent`. Keep the top bar solid only when the art lives in the content row below it (Codex, Fluence).
   - **Banner collapses\*.** The same setting collapses `HeroArt` and any wrapper sized by `GameBannerHeight` (`HeroClip`, card media): `Collapsed`, not `Hidden`, so the spacer floor applies and banner height has no effect.
   - **Sliders grey out\*.** The implicit `Slider` style (`DefaultControls/Slider.xaml`) has two `MultiDataTrigger`s, one per key `GameBannerHeight` and `GameBannerDarken`: `{Binding Children[0].Tag, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Grid}}` = the key (ThemeModifier tags each row label with its key) and the setting = True set `IsEnabled` False and `Opacity` 0.4.
   - **Branded banner darkening\*.** Right after the banner's `PART_ImageBackground` (under the theme's own fade into the page): `<Rectangle Fill="{DynamicResource GameBannerTintBrush}" Opacity="{DynamicResource GameBannerDarken}" IsHitTestVisible="False" />`, then the floor layer: the same brush at `Opacity="0.5"` with `Tag="{DynamicResource GameBannerDarken}"` and a `DataTrigger` (`Tag` = 0 -> `Collapsed`), so any value above 0 starts at 50% and stays visible. `GameBannerTintBrush` (a plain `SolidColorBrush` in `Constants.template.xaml`, listed in ThemeModifier as "Banner darkening color") is the theme's own dark color, not black: its brand art tint if the source has one (keep it, e.g. Tumbleweed's red `ArtTintBrush`), otherwise its darkest branded surface (Ace's olive panel, Dropzone's navy, Chakram's teal selection). Use a solid token with no alpha, or the slider can't reach full strength. Black only for black themes, paper for light ones. Say which color and why in `AGENTS.md`.
   - **Generators too.** An `art/` overview generator emits the same triggers and darkening layer (double the braces in Python f-strings); regenerate and diff against the views.
   - **Check:** in Playnite, with the setting on, look at a tall and a short background image (soft edge, see-through panels, no banner, both ThemeModifier banner sliders greyed out). With it off, drag Banner darkening from 0 to 1 and confirm the banner takes the theme's color.
   **TextBox and PasswordBox:** `MinHeight` = `ControlHeight`, and apply `Padding` once. WPF already passes it to `PART_ContentHost`, so do not also bind it to the host's `Margin` or the surrounding `Border`'s `Padding`. In `ComboBox`, `PART_EditableTextBox` gets `MinHeight="0"`.
   **TabControl:** keep the `TextBlock` around `ContentPresenter ContentSource="Header"`, and keep `Foreground` = `TextBrush` on the `TabItem`. Idle, hover and selected header colours go on that `TextBlock` with `TargetName`, because the tab page inherits the tab's own colour. Check the labels in a game's edit dialog.
   **Button height:** in the base style's `Style.Triggers`, `<Trigger Property="Height" Value="NaN">` sets `MinHeight` = `ControlHeight`, so a button given an explicit size keeps it.
   **Button:** ThemeModifier hardcodes its edit pencil and restore X at `Width="41"` in fixed 41px columns. Keep the base `Button` style's `Width == 41` detection trigger; local plugin widths cannot be overridden by a style setter. Pin `Height`, `MinWidth`, `MinHeight`, `MaxWidth` and `MaxHeight` to 41 internally, set `Padding="0"`, both content alignments to `Center`, and `FontSize` to 16. Apply a uniform `LayoutTransform` with `ScaleTransform ScaleX="0.7804878048780488" ScaleY="0.7804878048780488"` (32/41): the button occupies **32x32px** in layout and its glyph, border and decoration shrink proportionally, including explicitly sized child glyphs. Do not use `RenderTransform`, which leaves the old layout size. Auto-width buttons keep their normal padding. `validate-extension.ps1` enforces the square and scale on every theme.
   **Effects and motion:** when the source has glows, light, lightning, energy or other animated chrome, recreate it instead of leaving flat fills. Generate the sprites from measured specs with a deterministic `art/` script. Review the script and its output, color the sprites through brush-filled `OpacityMask`s, and animate with storyboards. Rules, commands and the masked-banner trap: [reference.md](reference.md) -> Effects and motion.
   **Required interactive layer (every new theme):** each item in the theme's own visual language, from the source, never copied from another theme. Recipes and pitfalls: [reference.md](reference.md) -> Interactive layer; worked example: Cloudbank.
   - **Play hover:** animated in and out (fade, never snap), with the source's signature effect (bloom, arcs, sheen, ink...) and a separate pressed layer.
   - **Rounded grid covers:** clip cover art, its background and scrims to the same rounded shape; leave the outside transparent so library artwork shows through. Do not paint corner patches in the page color. Keep names and hover controls usable and check hover at 125% and 150% scaling for mask repaint artifacts.
   - **Cover hover** (`GridViewItemStyle.xaml`): an animated hover state distinct from the static selected state (brackets, outline, bloom, frame...).
   - **Cover hover controls** (`DerivedStyles/GridViewItemTemplate.xaml`, a `GridTileButton` style): restyle Playnite's Play and Info overlay buttons in the theme's shape, with themed glyphs (`IconPlay`, `IconDownload`, `IconInfo` drawn in the source's icon language, not stock pack glyphs), a staggered animated entrance and an animated hover.
   - **Running game indicator:** a frame and tint in the running colour (`RunningFrame`, `RunningWash`) plus an animated motif on the launching or running game's details row, cover, list view row (`DefaultControls/ListView.xaml` overlay) and over the game page's Play / context action cell (`RunningActionIndicator`), in a `RunningIndicatorBrush` that selection and hover never use, still visible when the item is selected, slower while running than while launching. Contract and recipe: [reference.md](reference.md) -> Running game indicator.
   - **Empty game page:** implement it in both `Views/GridViewGameOverview.xaml` and `Views/DetailsViewGameOverview.xaml`. With no game selected, hide the game content and show a designed empty state (a source motif plus `LOCErrorNoGameSelected`, idle animation only while visible, and never through a `RenderTransform` from a `Style` trigger: that crashes Playnite, see Builds but looks wrong below). Keep the details `PART_ScrollViewHost` explicitly `Visibility="Visible"`: the inherited `DetailsScrollViewer` style otherwise collapses on a null DataContext and hides the empty state too. Decorative title suffixes and other theme additions hide when their data is empty.
   - **Empty-state regression check:** verify a fresh empty selection and selected game -> grid view -> details view with selection cleared, then select a game again. Both views must show their empty state when no game is selected and restore the content afterward; checking only grid view is insufficient.
   - **Generated graphic assets:** where flat fills look thin next to the source (glows, light rays, textures, ornaments, backdrops), generate image assets (white masks for anything themed, deterministic generator in `art/`) instead of shipping a plain color. Keep backgrounds behind dense content (library lists, covers) calm: solid or gradient, no busy texture.
   - **Effects follow ThemeModifier:** every glow and animated layer is filled with a theme brush, no baked colors.
10. **Final screenshots:** re-render with `.\scripts\take-screenshots.ps1 -Extension <key>` after the last token or XAML change (`art/screenshot-details.png`, `screenshot-settings.png`; Playnite is never captured). Check [preview parity](theme-preview-review.md#after-xaml) against the implemented XAML. Update the preview for intentional implementation differences.
11. **Build:** `.\scripts\build-theme.ps1 -Extension mytheme -Deploy -Restart [-DeployPath <Themes folder>]` (auto-sets active theme and restarts a running Playnite; closed stays closed unless `-Launch`). Warns about required shared keys still missing.
12. **Finish:** `info/icon.png` (512x512, `.\scripts\render-addon-icon.ps1 -Svg logo.svg -Extension <key>`, default orange mark: never pass `-Color`, all tiles share it), database listing `info/danitesler_<key>.yaml`, `AGENTS.md` in the section order of `src/themes/AGENTS.md` -> Per-theme notes (only what differs from the shared anatomy), then `.\scripts\validate-extension.ps1 -Extension mytheme -Mode Package`. Check in ThemeModifier that palette edits (Editor tab) and shared brushes (Edit constants) recolor the restyled controls, and that its pencil / restore buttons read as 32x32 squares with proportionally scaled content with the whole glyph visible (the `Width == 41` trigger). **README:** `node scripts/generate-readmes.mjs` writes the theme's `README.md` and its row links in the root `README.md` (the row's name and description are written by hand); `npm run check:readmes` must pass. **Branding:** a theme modeled on someone else's design system, app or game gets its own abstract name that only echoes the source (Fluence, Primo, Shade) or a plain "<Source>-inspired" name, never an official-sounding one, ships `info/NOTICE-<Dir>.txt` and an "unofficial, not affiliated" listing description, and draws no owner logo or mark ([theme guide](../../src/themes/AGENTS.md#trademarks--branding)).
